fields.Name: CRD-04 - Operations
fields.Description: Verify the server-side operations that span several records: creating a program with its first version, copying a version into a new draft, reordering a version's tree, setting up an organization and creating a committee for a program's organization, each as one unit of work that leaves nothing behind when refused, including under concurrent calls.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All twenty cred-operations checks pass on scratch programs and run-unique organizations, including organization deletes refused while members or programs exist, a program with a blank name, prefix or subject noun refused with a sentence, and a committee created for a program's organization by its staff only (a blank name, an unknown type, a duplicate name, another organization's program and a caller without the staff role each refused, and two simultaneous calls giving one committee); the sample program is left unchanged.
